rationale: The morning spike to $34.31 has already fully faded — price sits at 24% of the day's range, below the 9-EMA and 5-min VWAP (a fade-continuation signal), yet still well above session VWAP on a day when SPY is up ~1% (a support-hold/counter-fade risk), so the two directional cases directly conflict. Shorting is operationally compromised with no borrow rate, float, or short-interest data on a thin micro-cap, and longing here means buying into short-term downside momentum just above the $32.09 day-low. With 5-minute ATR collapsed to $0.04, only 65 minutes left, and no news to explain the spike, there is no measurable edge in either direction — skipping is the highest-expectation action.
